Overview:

The Revenue Policy Analyst is responsible for the development of revenue policy and strategy within the newly established Revenue Strategy Unit (RS). This is a great opportunity for team members currently working within Local Health Networks (LHNs) to contribute to system-wide policy development and gain experience within the Department. 

The unit supports and manages key policy initiatives designed to support the optimisation of revenue outcomes for public health services. The unit's purpose is to provide system leadership, though policy and guidance to revenue-based teams working across the Local Health Networks, who are responsible for optimising revenue outcomes and meeting revenue compliance requirements. It achieves this through:

The development and maintenance of policies and guidelines (policy and governance).

Strategy, education, and business reform across all patient revenue streams.

The provision of a level 2 helpdesk, supporting Local Health Networks to get policy and practice right every time.

Commonwealth department and jurisdictional consultation and engagement on system wide issues-matters.

Periodic and ad hoc Revenue Compliance reviews.

The Revenue Policy Analyst will be involved in funding matters and audits and the provision of expert policy related advice to Local Health Networks (LHNs) to ensure that SA Health policies are implemented and adhered to.

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced and qualified Panel Beater to join either our AMA Group Solutions or Capital S.M.A.R.T Repairs team to undertake quality workmanship to ensure vehicles are returned to their pre-accident condition. Check received parts are correct and for defects
Disassemble vehicle as per Job Sheet
Label and store parts

Check new parts are correct and not damaged and communicate defects to Parts Manager/Production Manager

Build and maintain colour library

Buff and denib vehicle

Reassemble vehicle

Clean workbay and workshop areas
Coach apprentices when required

Trade qualified Panel Beater 
Previous experience in a similar role
Strong commitment to work in a safe manner
Excellent communication skills
High attention to detail
Able to work effectively and collaboratively with the team
Ability to meet strict deadlines
Be reliable, punctual & hardworking

Team environment
Ongoing training
Career opportunity
Latest tools, equipment and process
Great opportunity to earn big $$$ for competent and efficient tradespeople
Junior-Mid experienced tradesperson $60-$80k

AQF Certificate III in Automotive Refinishing Technology or equivalent or relevant experience
Minimum 4 years experience

## Position Overview
We are looking for a driven and commercially astute ICT Account Manager to join our team and take ownership of a portfolio of client accounts across the technology sector. In this role, you will be responsible for managing and growing existing client relationships, identifying new business opportunities, and delivering tailored ICT solutions that meet each client's unique needs. You will serve as the primary point of contact for clients, ensuring high levels of satisfaction and long-term retention. The ideal candidate is a confident communicator with a strong technical understanding and a proven track record in B2B technology sales.
## Key Responsibilities
- Manage and nurture a portfolio of existing client accounts, serving as the primary relationship point and ensuring ongoing satisfaction with ICT products and services
- Identify and pursue upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts to drive revenue growth and deepen client engagement
- Prospect and develop new business opportunities by researching and compiling lists of potential client organisations using trade directories, industry publications, and other relevant sources
- Maintain up-to-date knowledge of the company's full range of ICT products and services, as well as competitor offerings and broader market conditions, to effectively position solutions
- Coordinate the preparation and delivery of professional sales proposals, tenders, and presentations tailored to client requirements and business objectives
- Follow up with clients following the delivery of ICT goods and services to confirm satisfaction, manage any required modifications, and resolve issues promptly and professionally
- Collaborate with internal technical, procurement, and support teams to ensure seamless delivery and implementation of solutions for clients
- Develop and maintain accurate records of all client interactions, sales activity, and pipeline progress using CRM tools and reporting systems
- Negotiate pricing, contract terms, and service agreements in line with company policies and client expectations
- Attend industry events, conferences, and client meetings to strengthen relationships and stay informed of emerging trends and technologies
- Prepare and present regular sales forecasts, account reviews, and performance reports to management
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Demonstrated experience in ICT account management, technology sales, or a related B2B sales role
- Strong understanding of computer hardware, software, networking, cloud services, and managed IT solutions
- Proven ability to meet and exceed sales targets while maintaining high levels of client satisfaction
- Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels
- Ability to analyse client needs and match them to appropriate ICT solutions effectively
- Proficiency in CRM platforms and Microsoft Office Suite for pipeline management and reporting
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities simultaneously
- A collaborative mindset with the ability to work cross-functionally with technical and operational teams
- Valid Australian driver's licence and willingness to travel for client meetings as required
## Preferred Qualifications
- Tertiary qualification in Information Technology, Business, Commerce, or a related discipline
- Relevant vendor certifications such as Microsoft, Cisco, AWS, or similar technology partnerships
- Experience working with government, enterprise, or public sector clients
- Familiarity with tendering processes and the preparation of formal RFT or RFQ responses
- Experience using Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar CRM platforms at an advanced level
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and high-performing team that values innovation, integrity, and professional growth
- Access ongoing training, vendor certifications, and clear pathways for career advancement within the ICT sector
- Enjoy a flexible working environment with hybrid arrangements available to support work-life balance
- Competitive remuneration package including an attractive base salary, superannuation, and performance-based incentives
- Work with a diverse and evolving portfolio of clients across a range of industries, keeping your day varied and your skills sharp
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

We are seeking a dedicated Parts Interpreter for a client to join their team in Brisbane. This is a full-time position based in East and North East of Brisbane QLD , offering an exciting opportunity to work in the automotive trades industry. As a Parts Interpreter, you will play a crucial role in identifying, sourcing, and interpreting vehicle parts information for customers and internal teams. Your expertise will be essential in ensuring accurate parts matching, supporting technical inquiries, and maintaining the efficiency of our operations. This position is integral to our customer service excellence and operational success.

What you'll be doing
Interpreting and decoding vehicle identification numbers (VINs) to identify correct parts specifications
Searching parts catalogues and databases to locate appropriate components for various vehicle makes and models
Providing accurate parts information to customers, mechanics, and internal team members
Cross-referencing parts across different manufacturers and suppliers to ensure compatibility
Assisting in resolving parts-related inquiries and discrepancies
Maintaining detailed records of parts requests and interpretations
Collaborating with sales, warehouse, and technical teams to ensure efficient parts procurement and delivery
Staying current with automotive industry changes, new model releases, and parts nomenclature updates

What we're looking for
Proven experience working as a Parts Interpreter, Parts Coordinator, or similar role within the automotive industry
Strong knowledge of vehicle identification systems and parts cataloguing methodologies
Proficiency in using automotive parts management systems and databases
Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in identifying and cross-referencing components
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical information clearly
Capability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple inquiries simultaneously
Problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot parts-related challenges
A valid driver's licence and willingness to engage with the automotive sector professionally
Preferred: Knowledge of multiple vehicle manufacturers and familiarity with common parts categories across different vehicle types

What we offer
Our client is committed to supporting their employees' professional development and wellbeing. They offer a competitive full-time position with the opportunity to develop expertise in automotive parts interpretation. Their team values collaboration, continuous learning, and career progression. They provide a supportive work environment where your technical knowledge is valued and your contributions make a direct impact.

Specialises exclusively in automotive recruitment, backed by over a decade of hands-on industry experience. With 13+ years working within dealerships, we understand workshop pressures, staffing challenges, and the urgency of finding reliable, skilled talent. Our deep industry knowledge and strong candidate network allow us to deliver fast, accurate, dealership-ready hiring solutions. We are passionate about supporting the automotive community and maintaining the highest standards in parts interpretation and customer service.

Travel Agency Manager

Happy Travels is Australia’s leading backpacker travel agency, built on a passion for adventure and a commitment to creating unforgettable experiences. Despite the challenges faced by the travel industry in recent years, we’ve continued to grow by staying focused on what matters most - our people and our travellers.

We’re more than just a booking service. We’re a tight-knit, energetic team dedicated to helping backpackers and tourists make the most of their time in Australia, Fiji, and New Zealand. From once-in-a-lifetime tours to hidden local gems, we connect travellers with experiences that turn trips into lifelong memories.

At Happy Travels, it’s all about people, connection, and adventure.

Role Overview:

As a Travel Agency Manager, your primary focus will be to oversee the operations of our travel agency, ensuring exceptional service delivery and maximising sales performance. You will lead a team of Travel Sales Consultants, motivating and guiding them to achieve sales targets and provide outstanding customer experiences. A crucial part of your role will be the recruitment, training, and development of staff, ensuring they are equipped with the skills and knowledge to excel in their roles.

Key Responsibilities:
- Leading and overseeing the overall operations and strategic direction of the travel agency.
- Developing and implementing business plans and strategies to achieve company objectives and targets.
- Managing financial aspects, including budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance analysis.
- Building and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders, such as travel suppliers, partners, and clients.
- Analysing market trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities and threats in the industry.
- Recruiting, training, and mentoring staff members to ensure a high level of professionalism and service quality.
- Setting performance goals and KPIs for the team, monitoring progress, and providing guidance as needed.
- Driving sales and revenue growth through effective marketing, pricing strategies, and product offerings.
- Developing and maintaining operational policies, procedures, and standards to ensure efficiency and compliance.
- Handling escalated customer issues and complaints, seeking resolution, and maintaining customer satisfaction.
- Negotiating contracts and agreements with suppliers to secure favourable terms and conditions.
- Staying updated on industry regulations, compliance requirements, and best practices.
- Utilising technology tools and systems to streamline operations and enhance customer experience.
- Analysing data and metrics to evaluate performance, identify areas for improvement, and make informed decisions.
- Representing the company at industry events, conferences, and trade shows to network and promote services.
- Monitoring and managing risk factors, such as safety, security, and legal liabilities, to protect the company’s interests.
- Fostering a positive work culture and environment that encourages teamwork, innovation, and continuous improvement.

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- A passion for travel and a commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences.

JBS Australia is Australia's largest and most respected meat and food processing company, employing thousands of people across the country. We are currently seeking a motivated and experienced IT Coordinator to join our team at JBS Dinmore.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is passionate about developing people, driving performance, and creating a strong culture of safety, quality, and continuous improvement within a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

About the Role
As an IT Coordinator at Dinmore Plant, you will be responsible for maintaining and supporting all plant IT systems to ensure operational efficiency. This role includes installing and configuring hardware and software, performing preventative maintenance, and troubleshooting technical issues. The position requires strong problem-solving skills, effective communication with non-technical users, and the ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced environment. The IT Coordinator plays a key role in minimising downtime, supporting continuous improvement, and ensuring reliable technology performance across the site. This is a full-time role with annual salary not less than $79,423.00 plus superannuation.

Your key responsibilities include:
Perform preventative and scheduled maintenance on all plant IT assets to ensure optimal performance and reliability.
Install and configure new hardware, including desktop computers and industrial printers, to support operational needs.
Deploy and configure software across multiple platforms, ensuring compatibility and functionality.
Modify, configure and customise existing software applications and system settings to meet operational requirements and improve user functionality and efficiency.
Assess software and hardware requirements and recommend appropriate technical solutions to meet operational and user needs across the plant environment.
Configure, implement and maintain local computer networks and connectivity solutions to support business systems and operational equipment.
Assist with the design, maintenance and updating of internal web-based platforms, intranet resources or business websites to support operational and communication requirements.
Monitor, diagnose, and resolve daily IT issues throughout the plant, providing timely and effective support.
Troubleshoot and resolve user-related problems as they arise, minimising downtime and disruption.
Escalate complex issues to the broader IT support team while maintaining accountability for resolution and closure.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to facilitate smooth IT operations.
Prepare reports and track data to support decision-making and continuous improvement.
About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:
AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma plus 1 year of full-time relevant experience. Alternatively, at least 3 years of relevant experience and/or relevant vendor certification may substitute for the formal qualifications.
Previous experience working with varied IT hardware, software, and operating systems.
Ability to work autonomously as well as part of a greater team.
Highly developed interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills – with the ability to explain technical issues to a non-technical user base.
Highly developed time management skills, including prioritising tasks and meeting conflicting deadlines.
Strong attention to detail.
Ability to work effectively in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
High standard of computer literacy.
Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and diagnostic skills.
Previous experience in a food manufacturing/processing environment would be preferable.

What We Offer
Career development opportunities within a global organisation
Supportive leadership team and collaborative work environment
Access to employee benefits and wellbeing programs
Opportunity to make a genuine impact on workforce capability and employee success
Long-term career opportunities with one of Australia's leading employers
If you are passionate about developing people and want to be part of a business that values safety, teamwork and continuous improvement, we would love to hear from you.

The ad is valid for 28 days.,

Apply now and help shape the future workforce at JBS Dinmore!
